Show me your two best value-for-money options and compare them.
Two strong value-focused options are:
Dental insurance plus HSA/FSA funds: Insurance may cover a percentage or set amount of Invisalign treatment, sometimes up to $3,000, subject to your plan’s orthodontic lifetime maximum. You could then use pre-tax HSA or FSA dollars toward the remaining balance. This may offer the lowest total out-of-pocket cost if your plan includes Invisalign.
Dental-office financing or a payment plan: Many dental offices offer payment arrangements that spread the cost over time. This may be the better fit if your insurance does not cover Invisalign or if you want to preserve your HSA/FSA funds, but compare the payment terms and any financing costs.
For overall value, I’d check the insurance-plus-HSA/FSA option first, then compare its remaining balance and terms with the dental office’s financing option. Your MyInvisalign™ App may also include an Insurance Verification Tool to help check your orthodontic benefits.
